lines.japanese: 「げっ、羽田」
lines.english: “Crap. Haneda.”

lines.japanese: 「めんどくせーのに会っちゃったなァ……」
lines.english: “Had to run into the biggest pain in the ass...”

lines.japanese: 「あ、あー悪り、いまおまえと遊んでる暇ないから。ほんじゃ」
lines.english: “Uh, sorry, man. I don't have time to hang out with you right now. Later.”

lines.japanese: どの俺が追いかけますか？
lines.english: Which of us will chase him?

lines.japanese: 「もっ！」
lines.english: “M-Mo!”

lines.japanese: 「ももももももも森里君ッ！」
lines.english: “M-m-m-m-m-Morisato!”

lines.japanese: 「だあっ！　うぜえ！」
lines.english: “Gah! You're so annoying!”

lines.japanese: 「喜んでねーよ！」
lines.english: “I'm not happy to see you!”

lines.japanese: 「ねえ待って、待ってよ森里君、俺を置き去りにしてどこに行くの！　浮気？　おれ浮気は許さないよ！　必殺、ハニー・スウィートナイト・ランデヴー！」
lines.english: “Wait, Morisato, wait! Where are you going without me? Are you cheating? I won't stand for cheating! Finishing move: Honey Sweet-Night Rendezvous!”

lines.japanese: 「抱きつくなあああ鬱陶しい！」
lines.english: “Quit hugging me, you annoying freak!”

lines.japanese: 「あれっ！　森里君ちょっと太った？　抱き心地がいつもと違うよ？」
lines.english: “Huh? Did you gain some weight, Morisato? You feel different in my arms.”

lines.japanese: 「きめえこと言ってんじゃねえええ！」
lines.english: “Stop saying creepy shit!”

lines.japanese: 「迎えてねええええええ──！」
lines.english: “I'm not welcoming youuuuu!”

lines.japanese: 「フゥー、フゥー……」
lines.english: “Huff, huff...”

lines.japanese: 「ははは、森里君は今日も元気だなあ」
lines.english: “Ha-ha-ha. You're full of energy today too, Morisato.”

lines.japanese: 「うるせえ……もうツッコむ気力もねえ……頼むから黙っててくれ……」
lines.english: “Shut up... I don't even have the energy to yell at you anymore... Please, just stop talking...”

lines.japanese: 「いや、お言葉だけど森里君、そのぐらいで息が上がってるようじゃダイエットは成功しないよ」
lines.english: “I hate to say it, Morisato, but if that little exercise leaves you winded, your diet's never going to work.”

lines.japanese: 「誰がダイエットしてるなんつったんだよ……つうか……俺はべつに太ってねえんだよ……」
lines.english: “Who said I was on a diet...? Besides... I'm not fat...”

lines.japanese: 「ええ？　おかしいなあ……さっき抱いた感触だと、先月より１～２キロは──」
lines.english: “What? That's strange... Judging by how you felt in my arms, you're one or two kilos heavier than last month—”

lines.japanese: 「ごめん。俺が悪いならホント謝る。だから、頼むからこんな往来で、誤解されるようなことは言わないで」
lines.english: “I'm sorry. If I did something wrong, I sincerely apologize. Just please stop saying things people could misinterpret in the middle of the street.”

lines.japanese: 「でも森里君は将来ハゲ確定なのに、そのうえ肥満症の危険まであったら幼馴染みの女の子にも嫌われちゃうよ」
lines.english: “But you’re already guaranteed to go bald someday, Morisato. If you’re at risk of obesity too, even your childhood friend won’t want you around.”

lines.japanese: 「ばっ、馬鹿言ってんじゃねえよ。あいつはどうせ俺なんかより、おまえ……っつうか、おまえン中の一人を……」
lines.english: “D-don't talk shit. She'd rather have you anyway... Or, well, one of the guys inside you...”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、大丈夫。香田なんて俺ぜんぜん興味ないから」
lines.english: “Oh, don't worry. I have absolutely no interest in Kouda.”

lines.japanese: 「それはそれでなんかムカつくなあ、てめえ！」
lines.english: “Somehow that pisses me off too, asshole!”

lines.japanese: 「おおーっとっと……のこった！　のこったのこった！」
lines.english: “Whoooa there... Hold your ground! Hold it, hold it!”

lines.japanese: 「ひとをお相撲さんキャラにするなあああ！」
lines.english: “Stop turning me into a sumo character!”

lines.japanese: 「そうだ森里君。この際だから太ったついでに、土俵入りを狙って大幅ウェイトアップに励んでみてはどうかな」
lines.english: “I know, Morisato. Since you’ve already put on weight, why not really bulk up and make your sumo debut?”

lines.japanese: 「太ってねーよハゲ」
lines.english: “I'm not fat, baldy.”

lines.japanese: 「そして俺を相手にサバ折りの練習をするってのはどうかな！」
lines.english: “And how about practicing the rib-crusher throw on me?”

lines.japanese: 「おまえ……大概うざいけど、今日はいつにも増して鬱陶しいテンションだな」
lines.english: “You're always annoying, but today you're even more obnoxiously hyper than usual.”

lines.japanese: 「森乃里関も元気出していこうよ」
lines.english: “Cheer up, Wrestler Morinosato!”

lines.japanese: 「勝手に四股名つけてんじゃねえええええ！」
lines.english: “Don't make up a ring name for me!”

lines.japanese: 「うおおおおっとっとっと……さすがです横綱・森乃里、見事な押し出しです！」
lines.english: “Whoooa there... That’s our grand champion Morinosato! A magnificent push-out!”

lines.japanese: 「もういい……疲れた……」
lines.english: “Enough... I'm tired...”

lines.japanese: 森里君の精気をすべて奪いさるほど、俺は高ぶっていた。
lines.english: I was so worked up that I had drained every last ounce of vitality from Morisato.

lines.japanese: というわけで、森里君の笑顔を見ていたら、いつの間にか俺たちは再びひとりになっていた。
lines.english: And so, as I watched Morisato smile, at some point we had become one again.

lines.japanese: 俺たちの厄介な問題を瞬時に解決してしまうなんて、やっぱりさすがの森里君だ。
lines.english: Solving our troublesome problem in an instant—Morisato truly was everything I expected of him.

lines.japanese: ふたりの友情を祝福するように、東の空も明るみだしてきた。
lines.english: As if to celebrate the friendship between us, the eastern sky began to brighten.

lines.japanese: きょう一日で署名の方もいい具合に集まったし、まあ上出来だろう。
lines.english: We'd collected a decent number of signatures over the course of the day too. All in all, a fine result.

lines.japanese: こうして小鳩のために走りまわる俺たちの冬場所巡業は、森里君の活躍によって千秋楽を迎えたのである。
lines.english: And with Morisato's valiant performance, the winter sumo tour on which we had raced around for Kobato reached its final day.

lines.japanese: ありがとう、森乃里。
lines.english: Thank you, Morinosato.

lines.japanese: 負けるな、森乃里。
lines.english: Never give up, Morinosato.

lines.japanese: 強いぞ強いぞ、森乃里。
lines.english: You're strong, you're strong, Morinosato.

lines.japanese: めでたしめでたし。
lines.english: And they all lived happily ever after.
